summary: Wires a new DELETE /api/v1/me (login required via isAuthenticated cookie JWT) to the existing deleteProfile controller, which permanently deletes the logged-in user's account, all their posts, and removes them from followers/following lists; also fixes the missing Post import that made deleteProfile crash, and changes suggested users to the last 5 instead of first 5 reversed.

statements.why: Endpoint is login-only and acts on the caller's own account (routes/userRoute.js:12-14, middlewares/auth.js), so no open hole; but it adds irreversible deletion of the account and all posts with no password re-check, and cleanup is partial/non-atomic (comments, likes, saved posts, chats not removed; if any post lookup fails after user.remove() the request errors mid-way). Owner is told nothing about this.

statements.text: • The v1 me part of your server changed in a way plain can't describe yet. Ask the agent what it does differently. /api/v1/me
statements.why: True but empty - it doesn't say a delete-account action was added.

misses.what: New DELETE /api/v1/me lets any logged-in user permanently delete their account and all their posts (and unfollow everyone); irreversible, no password confirmation.

Deletion is partial and not atomic: the user is removed first, then posts/follow lists loop; a missing post makes it fail half-way, and the user's comments, likes, saves and chats are left behind referencing a deleted user.
Suggested-users list now shows the last 5 candidate users instead of the first 5.
